entries.speaker: Arcade Spectator
entries.en: ...Who's that kid? He's amazing.

entries.speaker: Loud Spectator
entries.en: ...That's the King.

entries.speaker: Arcade Spectator
entries.en: Oh, I've heard about him.[n]He's just a little guy, huh?[n]Must still be in grade school...

entries.speaker: Arcade Spectator
entries.en: He's dual-wielding...?

entries.speaker: Loud Spectator
entries.en: Yeah, he's playing two opponents all by himself.

entries.speaker: Loud Spectator
entries.en: And it's still too easy for him.

entries.speaker: The King
entries.en: Well, I guess that's that.

entries.speaker: Arcade Spectator
entries.en: What a monster...
The King may have some tips[n]on how to defeat the cheater.
I should negotiate with him...

entries.speaker: The King
entries.en: ...What do you want?
Teach me some tricks.
Let's play a game.

entries.speaker: The King
entries.en: ...Nah. Sounds like too much work.

entries.speaker: The King
entries.en: Don't take it personal; I turn everyone[n]down... Later.
There's an annoying player.
There's an invincible player.

entries.speaker: The King
entries.en: Annoying, huh...? Oh, you mean that[n]guy who cheats.

entries.speaker: The King
entries.en: Invincible, huh...? You mean that[n]guy who cheats, right?

entries.speaker: The King
entries.en: It really makes me mad when he does that...

entries.speaker: The King
entries.en: But I can still beat him, so I don't[n]really care. Just forget about him.
He's bothering someone.
I won't let bad guys win.

entries.speaker: The King
entries.en: ...You sound like the Phantom Thieves.

entries.speaker: The King
entries.en: So, you're saying you wanna beat[n]the cheater?

entries.speaker: The King
entries.en: You seem like a nice guy, but...[n]just let it go.

entries.speaker: The King
entries.en: The Phantom Thieves are really cool,[n]aren't they!?

entries.speaker: The King
entries.en: Are you a fan, too?[n]Have you ever met them?
I saw their first success.
They came to my school.

entries.speaker: The King
entries.en: Oh, you mean at Shujin Academy?[n]Yeah, that was pretty awesome!

entries.speaker: The King
entries.en: But, um...

entries.speaker: The King
entries.en: Teaching you how to play Gun About[n]won't be easy...

entries.speaker: The King
entries.en: And I won't get anything out of it...
Let's make a deal.
I'll do anything.

entries.speaker: The King
entries.en: Geez, you're really persistent.[n]I'm just a grade schooler, y'know.

entries.speaker: The King
entries.en: How about this...

entries.speaker: The King
entries.en: I wanna get to know the Phantom Thieves.

entries.speaker: The King
entries.en: It's probably impossible, but if you can[n]help me do that, then I'll teach you how[n]to play.

entries.speaker: The King
entries.en: Well, whaddya say? Is it a deal?
Let's do it.
I'll see what I can do.
I'm reluctant, but...

entries.speaker: The King
entries.en: Whoa, seriously!?

entries.speaker: The King
entries.en: ...Wait, what? You're not gonna say no!?

entries.speaker: The King
entries.en: Wait, so is that a yes!?

entries.speaker: The King
entries.en: Well, if you really want to[n]THAT much, then...

entries.speaker: The King
entries.en: I thought for sure you were just gonna[n]give up... Wow, I didn't see this coming.

entries.speaker: The King
entries.en: But the Phantom Thieves hide their true[n]identities, right? Are you sure I can get to[n]know them?
What's your name?
I'll introduce you to them.

entries.speaker: The King
entries.en: Huh? You're gonna tell them my name?

entries.speaker: The King
entries.en: My name's Shinya Oda.

entries.speaker: The King
entries.en: Shinya[n]Tell the Phantom Thieves my name,[n]and have them post it somewhere[n]only they'd be able to access.

entries.speaker: The King
entries.en: That'll be good enough as an autograph,[n]and proof that they know my name.
